input.summary: Move governing law to New York and venue to the state and federal courts in New York County.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have moved the governing law from Wisconsin to New York and the exclusive venue to the state and federal courts in New York County, consistent with our playbook's accepted jurisdictions; Delaware, California or England and Wales (with London courts) would also work as a fallback. The rest of Sections 22.1 and 22.2, including the post-judgment enforcement consent, is unchanged.

ops.newText: the internal laws of the State of New York
